metadata.name: molpha
metadata.description: Molpha Oracle Solana Program - Merged from molpha-solana and molpha-feed

accounts.name: round_record
docs: Subscription or agent settlement record. No seeds constraint — same rationale as
`finalize_round` (owner + discriminator). PDA is re-derived in-handler against
the refund accounts for the funding path.

accounts.name: agent_escrow
docs: Agent path (`record.price > 0`): escrow PDA. Must be `None` for subscription rounds.

accounts.name: escrow_ata
docs: Agent path: escrow USDC ATA. Must be `None` for subscription rounds.

accounts.name: subscription
docs: Subscription path (`record.price == 0`). Must be `None` for agent rounds.

accounts.name: round_record
docs: Subscription (`["molpha_round", source_id, ts]`) or agent
(`["molpha_agent_round", agent, nonce]`) settlement record. No seeds constraint:
owner + discriminator suffice — only the two settle instructions can create this
account type, and both write complete state, so stored contents are trusted.

accounts.name: evidence_registry
docs: The registry snapshot both statements were signed against.

accounts.name: current_registry
docs: The live registry snapshot guilty nodes are evicted from. May equal `evidence_registry`.

accounts.name: evidence_registry
docs: The registry snapshot both statements were signed against.

accounts.name: current_registry
docs: The live registry snapshot guilty nodes are evicted from. May equal `evidence_registry`.

accounts.name: evidence_registry
docs: The registry snapshot the statement was signed against.

accounts.name: current_registry
docs: The live registry snapshot guilty nodes are evicted from. May equal `evidence_registry`.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless once `node.frozen_until` has passed; the protocol authority may reinstate
earlier.

accounts.name: escrow_ata
docs: The escrow's USDC ATA — source of the settled `price`. Pinned to `agent_escrow`.

accounts.name: consumer_delegate
docs: The handler checks the delegate PDA, owner/delegate fields, and discriminator before use.

types.name: Delegate
docs: Owner-scoped delegate authorization with persistent request quotas.

fields.name: status
docs: Owner pause / protocol freeze backstop.

fields.name: max_signers
docs: Per-delegate quorum ceiling; clamped to `plan.max_signers` at creation.

fields.name: epoch_cap
docs: Dormant: per-epoch credit ceiling for the future credit economy. Not enforced.

fields.name: epoch_spent
docs: Dormant: credits spent in the current epoch. Not enforced.

fields.name: epoch_id
docs: Dormant: epoch discriminator for `epoch_spent`. Not enforced.

fields.name: delegate_count
docs: Subscription delegate count after this addition.

fields.name: delegate_count
docs: Subscription delegate count after this removal.

fields.name: value
docs: Stored oracle bytes: raw payload (`FeedValueKind::Value`) or keccak digest
(`FeedValueKind::Hash`). Never longer than [`Feed::STORED_VALUE_LEN`].

fields.name: value
docs: Compacted payload stored on the feed (raw ≤32 bytes, or keccak digest).

types.name: FeedValueKind
docs: Whether [`Feed::value`] holds the raw oracle payload or a digest of a longer payload.

types.name: Gateway
docs: Bonded, Ed25519-signing gateway (v0.2 spec `gateway.authority`).
Holds endpoint metadata, bond, and reward accounting. Keyed by the gateway's Solana
authority key. `index` is the `gateway_index` referenced by `GatewayReceipt`.

fields.name: bond
docs: USDC bond held in the gateway bond ATA, slashable on a successful dispute.

fields.name: claimable_rewards
docs: Finalized fees, withdrawable via `claim_gateway_rewards`.

types.name: Node
docs: Permanent owner-keyed node identity, lifecycle, and reward account.
Historical registries retain this account address forever. Consequently the owner and
secp256k1 key fields are initialized once and never changed, and the account is never closed.
A tombstone binds this node *identity*, not the operator behind it — the same operator can
register a fresh wallet and a fresh secp256k1 key, which is inherent to permissionless
registration.

fields.name: frozen_until
docs: Unix timestamp a `Frozen` node becomes permissionlessly reinstatable via
`reinstate_node`. Unused for any other status.

fields.name: punished_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the most recent punishment, or `0` if never punished.

fields.name: commitment_addr
docs: The aggregate nonce commitment both statements were signed under.

fields.name: guilty_bitmap
docs: Intersection of the two signer bitmaps - the punished bits.

types.name: OffenceKind
docs: Node-fault offence types. Each carries a fixed [`Penalty`] — see [`OffenceKind::penalty`].

fields.name: max_delegates
docs: Max delegates/agents an owner on this plan may provision.

fields.name: protocol_fee
docs: Fixed protocol fee per settled round (v0.2 §4.2 / §6).

fields.name: dispute_window_slots
docs: Slots a settled round must wait before `finalize_round` can run (dispute window).

fields.name: gateway_bond_min
docs: Minimum USDC bond a gateway must post to settle receipts.

fields.name: challenger_bounty_bps
docs: Challenger reward, in bps of the slashed bond, on a successful dispute.

fields.name: agent_round_base
docs: Base price of an agent `FreshRound` request (USDC atomic units).

fields.name: agent_round_per_sig
docs: Per-required-signature price component of a `FreshRound` request.
Solvency invariant (ops-enforced): `agent_round_per_sig >= reward_per_signature`
and `agent_round_base >= registry.redundancy_buffer * reward_per_signature + gateway_fee`.

fields.name: agent_epoch_len_secs
docs: Length of the agent spend epoch (e.g. 86_400 for daily); must be > 0.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version the two attestations were signed against; also the version
`guilty_bitmap` on `PunishmentCase` indexes into.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Must equal `equivocation_evidence_hash(..)` over the fields above — validated in the
handler and reused as the `PunishmentCase` PDA seed (the anti-replay guard), mirroring how
`register_node` validates `secp256k1_key_fingerprint` against its own PDA seed.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version both statements were signed against; also the version `guilty_bitmap` on
`PunishmentCase` indexes into.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Must equal `nonce_reuse_evidence_hash(..)` over the fields above — validated in the
handler and reused as the `PunishmentCase` PDA seed (the anti-replay guard).

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version the statement was signed against; also the version `guilty_bitmap` on
`PunishmentCase` indexes into.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Must equal `unsolicited_signing_evidence_hash(..)` over the fields above — validated in the
handler and reused as the `PunishmentCase` PDA seed (the anti-replay guard).

types.name: PunishmentCase
docs: Permanent, on-chain record of an executed node punishment.
The PDA is seeded by `evidence_hash`, so `init` doubles as the anti-replay guard: the same
evidence can only ever be submitted once, independent of any per-offence terminal-status guard.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version the guilty bitmap indexes into.

types.name: Registry
docs: Immutable, version-addressed snapshot of the ordered node set and selection policy.
Only `nodes[..node_count]` is populated. Node addresses are stored as bytes to keep the
zero-copy layout POD-safe and exactly 8,208 bytes including the Anchor discriminator.

types.name: RegistryState
docs: Mutable pointer to the current immutable registry snapshot.

types.name: RoundReceiptRecord
docs: Per-round settlement record.

types.name: Secp256k1KeyClaim
docs: Permanent reservation for a secp256k1 node key.
The PDA is keyed by `keccak256(compressed_pubkey)`. Claims are intentionally never closed:
once a key has represented a Molpha node it cannot later be replayed for another identity.

types.name: SignedStatement
docs: One signed statement offered as punishment evidence: an aggregate Schnorr signature over
`value` for the duty tuple carried alongside it in the offence's args (e.g.
`PunishEquivocationArgs`, `PunishUnsolicitedSigningArgs`).

fields.name: agg_sig_s
docs: Aggregate Schnorr scalar `s`.

fields.name: commitment_addr
docs: Ethereum-style commitment address of the aggregate nonce `R`.

types.name: SigningContext
docs: The duty tuple one statement in a [`nonce_reuse_evidence_hash`] filing was signed under.
Distinct from equivocation and unsolicited-signing, where both statements in a filing always
share one duty tuple: nonce reuse spans two signing contexts by definition, so each statement
carries its own. `registry_version` is deliberately absent — both statements in a nonce-reuse
filing must be signed against the same registry version (cross-version reuse is out of scope,
mirroring the equivocation module doc's own cross-version limitation), so it lives once on
`PunishNonceReuseArgs` instead, where the pinned `evidence_registry` seed constraint needs it.

fields.name: agg_sig_s
docs: Schnorr signature R component

fields.name: signers_bitmap
docs: The offending coalition's full signer bitmap, as submitted.

fields.name: guilty_bitmap
docs: `signers_bitmap` minus the derived selection — the punished bits.
